howToApply: Visit the official website psc.uk.gov.in or ukpsc.net.in and read the advertisement carefully.
Go to ukpsc.net.in, click on ‘How to Apply’ in the Menubar, review Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions, then click ‘Apply Now’.
Fill in the Registration Form with correct details, create a password for login, and click ‘Submit’. Verify the filled information and confirm submission.
After Primary Registration, you will receive a message on your registered mobile number and email. Click ‘Click here to login’.
After login, fill in Educational Details starting with High School, then Intermediate, Graduate, and other qualifications. Upload Photo and Signature as per instructions.
After uploading Photo and Signature, accept the declaration and click ‘Continue’. Review all filled data carefully. If correct, tick the declaration and click ‘Proceed’.
Pay the application fee via Net Banking/Debit Card/Credit Card/UPI by clicking ‘Pay Now’ to complete the online application process.
Take a printout of the online application form by clicking ‘Print Application’ and keep it safe for future reference.
In case of any error after final submission, the candidate can cancel the application and re-apply; however, the fee paid will not be refunded and a fresh fee must be paid.
For technical issues, contact ukpschelpline@gmail.com.

howToApply: Visit the Bank’s official website at www.nainitalbank.bank.in and navigate to the Career section under the Recruitment tab.
Click on ‘Current Openings’ and then click on ‘APPLY ONLINE’.
Choose ‘Click here for New Registration’ and enter your Name, Contact details, and Email ID to get a Provisional Registration Number and Password.
Fill in the application form carefully. Use ‘SAVE AND NEXT’ to save progress.
Upload scanned photograph (4.5cm × 3.5cm, 20KB–50KB, JPG/JPEG), signature (10KB–20KB), left thumb impression (20KB–50KB), and hand-written declaration (50KB–100KB).
Also capture and upload a live photograph via webcam or mobile phone as instructed.
Preview the entire application form before final submission.
Click ‘COMPLETE REGISTRATION’ after verifying all details.
Proceed to the Payment tab and pay the application fee of Rs. 1500/- (including GST) online using Debit Card, Credit Card, Internet Banking, IMPS, Cash Cards, Mobile Wallets, or UPI.
After successful payment, an e-Receipt will be generated. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the online application form.
A candidate can apply for only one post. In case of multiple applications, only the latest valid (completed) application will be retained.
